data.description:
## Context / Problem
After the removal story (granitic-realisable-dolphin) lands, the shipped surface no longer matches the prose: `docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md:5` still reads `**Status:** Accepted` and `:66-69` claims `verify.overlap_enabled` "remains a permanent alias" (false since ADR 0116; `src/rebar/_config_sections.py:176` `_ALIASES = {}`); `docs/event-schema.md:71-72` names deleted modules as producers; `docs/config.md:156-179` describes the removed detector; `docs/llm-framework.md:460-482` documents the drain; and 14 kept modules carry comments citing `enrich_drain` or `overlap.queue`. The breaking change needs its release-notes entry. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
One prose-only change: rewrite the ADR status and note, the four event-type rows, the config key text, delete the drain sections, add the BREAKING entry and the CHANGELOG `Removed` block, and sweep stale comments. No behavior change; no generated file (the removal story regenerated them). The repo convention has no "Superseded" status token (every ADR is `**Status:** Accepted`; retirements are recorded by a `>` note at line 3, see `docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md:3`), and `docs/adr/README.md` is generated by slug keyword rather than status (`scripts/gen_adr_index.py`), so no index regen.

## Scope
- `docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md:5` becomes `**Status:** Retired 2026-09-06 — implementation removed (originally Accepted, epic only-crave-art); redesign tracked on epic fattish-plucky-bufflehead (62dc-535b-5d05-421d)`. Insert after `:3` a blockquote: "**Retired 2026-09-06 (implementation removed).** The overlap/enrichment implementation this ADR specified — the `enrich` verb, the write-path drain, the certification-time `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` producer, the BM25F retrieve plus pairwise judge, and the `[llm] overlap_*` tunables — was removed from rebar; the four event-type names `TICKET_DIGEST`/`ENQUEUE_ENRICH`/`CLAIM_ENRICH`/`DONE_ENRICH` stay recognized so historical stores parse. It was retired because the drain's write-path queue appended and pushed about 4 commits per ticket on the shared `tickets` branch, starving every other writer and diverging stores without bound (rebar-ticket 62ab-c11e-30c2-40be). The redesign is a design-record epic, `fattish-plucky-bufflehead (62dc-535b-5d05-421d)`; this file remains only as the historical design record." Replace `:67-68` "the old key remains a permanent alias" with "the old spelling was retired by ADR 0116 and no longer resolves".
- `docs/event-schema.md:71` becomes `| \`TICKET_DIGEST\` | retired producer (ADR 0086) | No maintained producer or consumer; the name is kept in \`_NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES\` and the store allowlist so historical events still parse; compaction preserves the files. |`; `:72` the same wording for the three queue types.
- `docs/config.md:156-172` delete; `:173-179` become the key's whole comment, headed `# ADVISORY create-time duplicate journal ONLY:`; `:209` and `docs/concurrency.md:459` drop "mirroring the enrichment drain"; `docs/config.md:425`, `docs/architecture.md:107`, `docs/reuse-surface.md:629` drop the `enrich` and `overlap/*` worker mentions; `docs/reuse-surface.md:237` and `docs/llm-framework.md:810` drop the `overlap/judge.py` example; `docs/llm-framework.md:257,259,285-301,521` per the removals and delete `:460-482` (whole drain section); `docs/exit-codes.md:178` delete the `enrich` row (conformance test checks missing rows only, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes_doc_conformance.py:47-52`); `docs/README.md:142` delete the calibration link; `.rebar/criteria_routing.json:125` delete `"**/enrich_drain*"` (and its quote at `docs/llm-framework.md:770`).
- `docs/release-notes.md`: insert before `:11` the heading `## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — the cross-ticket overlap/enrichment implementation (ADR 0086) is removed` with this body: the `enrich` CLI verb is removed (`rebar enrich` is now an unknown subcommand); the 13 `[llm]` keys `overlap_propositions_min`, `overlap_propositions_max`, `overlap_k`, `overlap_max_doc_freq`, `overlap_min_should_match`, `overlap_soak_min`, `overlap_lease_ttl_min`, `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min`, `overlap_conf_threshold`, `overlap_surface_cap`, `overlap_drain`, `overlap_drain_batch`, `overlap_drain_gate_budget_ms` and their 13 env vars `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_{PROPOSITIONS_MIN,PROPOSITIONS_MAX,K,MAX_DOC_FREQ,MIN_SHOULD_MATCH,SOAK_MIN,LEASE_TTL_MIN,REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN,CONF_THRESHOLD,SURFACE_CAP,DRAIN,DRAIN_BATCH,DRAIN_GATE_BUDGET_MS}` are removed with no tombstone (ADR 0116): a leftover `[llm] overlap_*` key in `rebar.toml` is silently ignored, because `[llm]` is a reserved section that the unknown-key warning and `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error` never inspect, so delete the keys; `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` keeps its name and now gates only the create-time same-title journal (`rebar create` stderr / `duplicate_warning`); `rebar review-plan` and MCP `review_plan` verdicts never carry an `overlap` key and the CLI's `overlap:` block is gone (no schema change; `plan_review_verdict.schema.json` never declared it); `rebar show` no longer emits `digest_freshness`; `rebar doctor` reports five lock legs (`enrich-drain` removed); `rebar.llm.enrich`, the `ticket_digest` and `overlap_verdict` contracts and schemas are gone from the library surface. Migration: delete the keys; remove `.rebar/enrich-drain.lock`, `.rebar/logs/enrich-drain.log` and `.rebar/enrich-gate.json` if present; historical `TICKET_DIGEST` and `*_ENRICH` events need no action.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: add `## [Unreleased]` / `### Removed` with a two-line summary pointing at the release-notes entry.
- Comment-only stale references in 14 kept src modules and 5 test docstrings are listed in this ticket's first comment.
- Leave untouched (other senses or history): `docs/experiments/**`, `docs/adr/0116-retire-config-aliases.md`, `docs/adr/0100-cli-command-and-capability-registry.md:31,35`, `docs/release-notes.md:57`, `CHANGELOG.md:34,55`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md:125,227,242`, `code_review_verdict.schema.json:45` and `completion_verdict.schema.json:87` (historical "e.g. overlap-judge" examples; editing would force a `types.py` regen for prose).

## Testing
Happy: `make verify` green (docs-only). Edge: `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check` exits 0 (title unchanged, no regen); `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes_doc_conformance.py -q` green; `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing` exits 0 after the overlay edit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'enrich_drain|llm\.overlap|overlap/\*|overlap_drain|REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP|digest_sidecar|ENQUEUE_ENRICH producer' -- docs/*.md docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md src .rebar AGENTS.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/adr/0116*' ':!CHANGELOG.md'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `sed -n '5p' docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md` starts with `**Status:** Retired 2026-09-06`; `grep -c 'permanent alias' docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md` prints `0`.
- [ ] `grep -nE '^## BREAKING \(pre-1.0\) — the cross-ticket overlap' docs/release-notes.md` matches at the first `##` heading, and `grep -o 'overlap_[a-z_]*' docs/release-notes.md | sort -u | wc -l` prints `13`.
- [ ] `grep -n 'retired producer (ADR 0086)' docs/event-schema.md` prints 2 rows.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check && python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing` exits 0.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Document the ADR 0086 retirement: docs sweep, ADR note, release notes
